title: TUI: SPEC integration — r[tui-*] rules and spec+design discipline
description: Every TUI feature lands with SPEC rules (r[tui-browser], r[tui-review], r[project-registry], ...), trycmd or jj-integration tests, and design decisions recorded in design issues before implementation — same spec+design approach as the rest of pebbles. Includes the close/rejected-status SPEC decision for the review queue.
